ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 6.00 Changi T1 no-show fee cannot be settled on this record, so it goes to a human reviewer and the money is held. The fare ledger remains at payment_status PENDING, with the SGD 6.00 neither collected nor refunded while review is pending (POL-NS-09).

What is established. The fare line is clean: the AIRPORT zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00; the resolution rule takes the greater, SGD 6.00, which is exactly the cancellation_fee line, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The driver did reach the pickup point: the driver-device trace carries 5 qualifying in-geofence fixes with a minimum distance to the pin of 96 m, inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, so the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met and the wrong-entrance route (POL-NS-03) is closed. The trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW (POL-NS-01(a) and (d) on their face).

What cannot be decided. Whether the driver then held position for the required 480-second AIRPORT dwell (POL-NS-01(c)). The only measurement of in-geofence dwell in the whole bundle is the trace's longest qualifying run of 255 seconds, from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36. That trace, EV-GPS-00210, is impaired: weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW (device clock 228 s ahead of the server, over the 90 s limb of POL-NS-08(a)), GPS_GAP (a 186 s gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 sitting exactly across geofence entry), LOW_COVERAGE (22.8%), TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD; it is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a) and (b), and it survives the discount only as a down-weighted trace that cannot alone decide the point. The 186-second gap conceals the very fact that would choose the answer: on face-value device stamps the first qualifying fix is 23:42:21 and the hold is short of 480 s, while corrected for the 228 s skew the same fix is 23:38:33 server time and the hold is comfortably over 480 s. The driver's statement that he waited 'more than eight minutes' and the trip record's 6.9-minute wait (EV-TRIP-00210, weight 0.4, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT — impaired, but not under POL-NS-08(a)–(d)) are irreconcilable with each other and with the trace, and neither is independent of the trace's measurement.

Because the ONLY evidence for the deciding fact — dwell — is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d), the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(e); independently, POL-NS-09(b) is engaged (two artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell and no clause resolves which is right) and confidence is capped by the trace at 0.25 under POL-GEN-02(2), below the 0.70 floor, engaging POL-NS-09(a) as well. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal, so no monetary ruling issues.

Open question for the reviewer: using the driver-device fixes with the 228 s clock skew removed, was the driver within the 150 m arrival radius at the 23:42:10 arrival marker and did he then hold position continuously for 480 seconds until the 23:49:05 cancellation — i.e. what do the un-gapped fixes across 23:39–23:42 show?

On the arguments. I accept the driver's points that the arrived event and the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination exist, and that the proximity test and fare itemisation are met — but none of these establishes the 480-second dwell, and driver compensation under POL-NS-07 depends on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full with no clause displacing it, which cannot be found here. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in 30 days against 156 completed trips, ratio 0.013, and rider no_show_disputes_30d of 1), so no compensation or POL-NS-07 escalation issues on this record. I accept the rider's point that EV-GPS-00210 carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0), which makes POL-NS-04(c) undecidable and neutral and is a trace defect under POL-NS-08(b) — no adverse inference may be drawn against the rider from the missing track — but it produces no refund either. I cannot act on the shortfall reading of the trace (255 s against 480 s) or on a waiting clock recomputed from the first qualifying fix, because both rest solely on the impaired trace and the gap covers the arrival moment; the same impairment is why the false-arrival referral in POL-NS-05(ii) is unavailable (qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, so POL-NS-05 is not triggered) and why the case escalates rather than refunding. The chat log EV-CHAT-00210 (weight 0.6, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) is missing messages 002 and 003 and decides nothing either way. No clause in the loaded policy produces a referral on these facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
